Should you run Props IN or Props OUT? In exploring the aerodynamics of FPV quadcopters, a comprehensive analysis reveals that the orientation of propellers-whether "in" or "out"-plays a crucial role in performance and efficiency. The "props out" configuration emerges as superior in several aspects. It enhances tolerance to object clipping by pushing obstacles away from the quadcopter. This setup also mitigates camera fouling issues when flying over grassy areas, as it prevents lens spatter. Moreover, it positively influences the control of the quadcopter, allowing for more effective management of roll, pitch, and yaw, and better conservation of angular momentum. The front motors in this configuration, facing cleaner air, exert more effort, thereby boosting aerodynamic efficacy and thrust. The video also delves into how different sides of the propeller blades, advancing and retreating, impact lift and thrust at varying speeds. Overall, the "props out" orientation is recommended for its enhanced authority in handling contacts, sharp turns, and its superior aerodynamic efficiency.
